paradigm_bases.name: 連用形 (Ren'youkei)
paradigm_bases.function: Continuative / Polite ます / Past た / Gerund て base

sound_euphony_onbin.i_onbin: k-stem / g-stem verbs in ren'youkei + te/ta change k/g to 'i' (書いた, 泳いだ).
sound_euphony_onbin.sokuonbin: t-stem / r-stem / w-stem verbs in ren'youkei + te/ta change to geminate 'っ' (待った, 取った, 買った).
sound_euphony_onbin.hatsuonbin: m-stem / b-stem / n-stem verbs in ren'youkei + te/ta change to moraic nasal 'ん' + voiced de/da (読んだ, 飛んだ, 死んだ).
